fields.description: Amount of Time in Mins allowed for Job Card Time to be in Future
fields.label: Future Time Mins

fields.description: The RM rate gets the discount below for each full step of Average Stock Age.
fields.label: RM Stock Age Step (Days)

fields.description: Discount on the RM Valuation Rate for each age step, to rank old RM higher on a Process Sheet.
fields.label: RM Rate Discount per Age Step

fields.description: A Job Card can use RM above its Calculated Qty up to this value, or up to RM Excess % of its RM value when that is higher. Above it, Bypass Qty Check is needed.
fields.label: Min RM Excess Value

fields.description: Allowed RM excess as a % of the value of the RM that the Job Card used.
fields.label: RM Excess %

fields.description: Calculate the Base Annual Sales for the Customer Rating from the Company Sales of the rating period. Base Annual Sales is then not used.
fields.label: Base Annual Sales from Company Sales

fields.description: Percent of the annual Company Sales (Net Total of submitted Sales Invoices) that a Customer must sell to get the full Sales Factor
fields.label: Base Annual Sales % of Company Sales

fields.description:
Total Value of Manufactured Items for which Process Sheet would be Automatically Created
Value = Qty * Valuation Rate
fields.label: Auto Process Sheet Value

fields.description: Safety stock factor (z) for the ROL of items ordered often. 1.65 gives about 95% of lead times without a stock-out.
fields.label: ROL Safety Factor

fields.description: Safety stock factor (z) for the ROL from consumption with Stock Entries. It is multiplied by the variation of the weekly consumption in the lead time.
fields.label: ROL Consumption Safety Factor

fields.description: An order line above this many times the median order qty of the item is a big order. Its qty is counted only up to that limit for the ROL.
fields.label: Big Order Multiple for ROL
Max Value Over Max Qty Allowed

fields.description: Enter Numbers separated by comma only
fields.label: ROL Calculation
Default Payment Terms for Zero Sales Rating
Max Transactions for Lead Time to Consider

fields.description: A stock quantity above this number shows as the Stock Cap Label. The website never shows the real quantity above the cap. Stock shows only when E Commerce Settings > Show Stock Availability is on, from the Website Warehouse of the Website Item.
fields.label: Website Stock Cap

fields.description: {cap} is replaced with the Website Stock Cap, for example 100+.
fields.label: Website Stock Cap Label

fields.description: The maximum number of characters in a website route, for example carbide/jobber-drills/c0gj-jobber-solid-carbide-drills-metric/cr0agbe00md1. Empty: 75. A template name in the route is cut to fit. A change applies on the next save of an Item Group.
fields.label: Website Route Max Length

fields.description: The maximum number of Item Groups in a category route, for example 2 for carbide/jobber-drills. Empty: 2. Item Group > Include in URL selects the groups.
fields.label: Website Route Max Depth

fields.description: The tracking page is unpublished these days after delivery. Empty: 7.
fields.label: Unpublish Days After Delivery

fields.description: A published tracking page is unpublished after these days, even when it is not delivered. Empty: 90.
fields.label: Published Ctrack Days

fields.description: An open tracking older than this is polled once more, then closed as Closed - No Update. Empty: 150.
fields.label: Auto Close Days

fields.description: DTDC and FedEx trackings older than this are not polled. Empty: 150.
fields.label: Max Track Days (API)

fields.description: Shipway trackings older than this are not polled. Empty: 60.
fields.label: Max Track Days (Shipway)

fields.description: An open tracking is polled when its last update is older than this. Empty: 6.
fields.label: Poll Every (Hours)

fields.description: The same, for accounts with webhooks. Empty: 24.
fields.label: Poll Every With Webhooks (Hours)

fields.description: A new AWB is sent to Shipway only in its first days. Empty: 20.
fields.label: Shipway Push Max Days
